description:
DECIDED 2026-09-06.

src/parser/lexer.rs:400 has fn, fnp, extern, defmacro, defmodule, defstruct,
defprotocol, defimpl. No def, no defp. The only def/defp anywhere in fixtures2 are
inside *.oracle.exs files -- real Elixir, hand-translated.

The oracle workflow means every fixture has a hand-written Elixir twin, so function
heads get retyped constantly and each retype is a chance to introduce a difference
the golden then blesses. Accepting def/defp makes the twin near-identical to the fz
source.

  "def"  => Tok::Fn
  "defp" => Tok::Fnp

Both spellings stay legal; existing code is untouched. Note  lambdas
are a separate production and are unaffected.

Update guides/modules.html:313, which currently documents fnp as the private form.
title: Accept def/defp as aliases for fn/fnp
